data.long_description:
Description:
Step into a spacious and thoughtfully designed 1-bedroom apartment offering 1,314 sq ft of comfortable living space. This home features a modern layout with bright interiors and large windows that fill the space with natural light, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere throughout. The open-plan living and dining area is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining guests, seamlessly connecting to a well-appointed kitchen fitted with quality finishes and ample storage. Each bedroom is generously sized and comes with built-in wardrobes, providing both comfort and practicality. The two bathrooms are elegantly designed with modern fixtures, ensuring convenience and style. A private balcony adds to the charm, offering a relaxing spot to unwind and enjoy the surroundings. This property is ideal for families or professionals seeking a blend of space, functionality, and contemporary design in a well-connected location.

Features:

1 Bedroom + Maids Room
2 Bathrooms
Size: 1,314 sq ft
Built-in wardrobes
Open-plan living and dining area
Modern kitchen with high-quality fittings
Floor-to-ceiling windows
Private balcony
Central air conditioning
Covered parking

Amenities:

Swimming pool
Fully equipped gym
24/7 security
High-speed elevators
Children’s play area
Landscaped areas
Retail and dining outlets nearby
